body:
Explains the children’s concerns about disguises, covens and attacks on the town.

Recorded role and choices

Kain reports that an object was dropped in a trap and explains the children’s understanding of how hags hide and organize. In February 2026, Kain warns that a hag can appear as different people or animals. Those conclusions remain the child’s testimony, offered during a specific investigation rather than promoted into a complete setting-wide rule about hags.
